displayIdentity.body: The speaker keeps the LORD before him, rests in hope, says his soul will not be left in Sheol nor the holy one see corruption, and ends with the path of life and joy in God’s presence.
displayIdentity.title: David speaks of presence, hope, and not being left in Sheol
